description: Projected range at 100% charge over time — a proxy for battery degradation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->'batteryCapacity'->>'value')::numeric AS value FROM (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.name, jsonb_build_object('value', COALESCE(to_jsonb(l.num), to_jsonb(l.value)), 'timeStamp', l.at)) AS data FROM state_fields f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.field_id) c.field_id, c.num, c.value, c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = (SELECT seq FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY c.field_id, c.at DESC) l ON l.field_id = f.id) s

SELECT (range_km*0.621371) / (battery_level/100.0) AS value FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=(SELECT id FROM vehicles LIMIT 1) AND battery_level > 10 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

WITH r AS (SELECT (range_km*0.621371) / (battery_level/100.0) AS range100, ts FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=(SELECT id FROM vehicles LIMIT 1) AND battery_level > 10) SELECT (SELECT range100 FROM r ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT range100 FROM r ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1) AS value

SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN battery_level < 30 THEN range100 END AS "<30% SoC", CASE WHEN battery_level >= 30 AND battery_level < 60 THEN range100 END AS "30-60% SoC", CASE WHEN battery_level >= 60 AND battery_level < 90 THEN range100 END AS "60-90% SoC", CASE WHEN battery_level >= 90 THEN range100 END AS "90-100% SoC" FROM (SELECT ts, battery_level, (range_km*0.621371) / (battery_level/100.0) AS range100 FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=(SELECT id FROM vehicles LIMIT 1) AND battery_level > 10 AND $__timeFilter(ts)) x ORDER BY ts

WITH pts AS (SELECT ts, battery_level, (range_km*0.621371) / (battery_level/100.0) AS range100 FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=(SELECT id FROM vehicles LIMIT 1) AND battery_level > 10 AND $__timeFilter(ts)), reg AS (SELECT regr_slope(range100, extract(epoch from ts)) AS slope, regr_intercept(range100, extract(epoch from ts)) AS intercept FROM pts) SELECT pts.ts AS time, reg.intercept + reg.slope * extract(epoch from pts.ts) AS "Trend" FROM pts, reg ORDER BY pts.ts

SELECT c.num AS value FROM state_changes c JOIN state_fields f ON f.id = c.field_id WHERE f.name = 'batteryTempMin' AND c.vehicle_seq = (SELECT seq FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND c.at > now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1
